channel.description: Latest articles from The Old House Life (theoldhouselife.com)

item.title: Almost six acres in the foothills of the NC mountains. C. 1947. $225,000
item.description: This is a pretty area of North Carolina. Nice acreage with this house! The home was built in 1947. It is located on 5.72 acres in Marion, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, an enclosed back porch, wood floors, stone fireplace, baseboards and an unfinished second floor. There is a detached carport with storage shed on the property. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,212 square feet. $225,000 Contact Brandon Braswell with Realty Group: 828homesales@gmail.com From the Zillow

item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! Circa 1880’s in Virginia. $140,000
item.description: Fixer Upper Alert! This house has potential! They probably need to come down on that price some. Or someone could make a much lower offer. The house was built sometime in the 1880’s. It is located on .3 acre in Crewe, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, some original wood floors, pretty mantels, nice staircase, double front doors, crown moulding, wide baseboards and a claw foot tub. There is a detached storage shed/workshop on the property. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,393

item.title: Sweet house overlooking the town! C. 1910 in Vermont. $249,500
item.description: This is a sweet house overlooking the town! Could easily live there and work room by room. The house was built in 1910. It is located in Montpelier, Vermont. The house features double back porches, wood floors, crown moulding, baseboards and a basement. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,112 square feet. $249,500 Contact Lucy Ferrada with Heney Realtors: 802-279-7735 From the Zillow listing: Perched on a hill with views overlooking the city, this three-bedroom home offers a wonderful opportunity

item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! C. 1920. Almost an acre in West Virginia. $135,900
item.description: Fixer Upper Alert! This house has a lot of potential! It’s a big house with over 4,000 square feet. The house was built in 1920. It is located on .89 acre in Huntington, West Virginia. By looking at third floor pictures, the roof probably needs some attention. The house features a covered back porch, wood floors, built-in shelving, crown moulding, wainscoting and a spacious kitchen. Six bedrooms, four bathrooms and 4,592 square feet. $135,900 Contact Michael M. Moore with Runyan and Associates R

item.title: Unique porch! Nice interior! Circa 1900 in Wisconsin. $319,900
item.description: This house has a unique porch! The interior is nice! The house was built in 1900. It is located on .84 acre in Appleton, Wisconsin. The house features an enclosed wrap around front porch, butler’s pantry, crown moulding, wood floors, baseboards, updated kitchen and built-ins. The house has a basement, large backyard and a detached garage. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,864 square feet. $319,900 Contact Stacey Hennessey with Acre Realty: 920-470-9692 From the Zillow listing: Location takes ce

item.title: Stone cottage! One acre in the North Carolina mountains! $225,983
item.description: I love stone houses! This cottage could be really nice with some TLC. The house was built in 1953. It is located on one acre in Jefferson, North Carolina. The house features a covered side porch, wood floors, chair rails, baseboards, crown moulding and a decent kitchen. There are mountain views from the house and it’s not far from the New River. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,541 square feet. $225,983 Contact Andrea B. Reeves with Regency Properties: 336-246-2307 From the Zillow listing: Com

item.title: Pretty setting! Love the long drive! Two acres in Virginia. $325,000
item.description: This house has a pretty setting! I love the long drive! The house was built in 1953. It is located on two acres in Gordonsville, Virginia. The house features an enclosed front porch, wood floors, baseboards and a spacious kitchen. Love the mature trees on the property. Just 20 minutes from Charlottesville. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,504 square feet. $325,000 Contact Joyce Washington with Long and Foster -Charlottesville: 434-953-0084 From the Zillow listing: Built in 1953 on 2 acres, thi

item.title: That’s a lot of green! Pretty house! C. 1935 in Alabama. $375,000
item.description: They must really like green! It’s a pretty house. The home was built in 1935. It is located on .28 acre in Montgomery, Alabama. The house features an arched front door, wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding, built-in shelving, exposed brick and updated bathrooms. There is a fenced in backyard. Five bedrooms, four bathrooms and 2,590 square feet. $375,000 Contact Lynn A. Peck with Aegis Michaud Properties: 334-271-2230 From the Zillow listing: Classic Old Cloverdale Charm with Modern Updates! L

item.title: TWO houses on three acres in Arkansas. Nice staircase and sunroom! $199,000
item.description: Love the sunroom and the staircase! This property has a large main house and there is a guest cottage on the property. The house was built in 1900. It is located on 3.32 acres in Texarkana, Arkansas. The house features a covered front porch, nice staircase, some original wood floors, built-in bookshelves, french doors, transom windows, sunroom and a spacious kitchen. Five bedrooms, six bathrooms and 4,699 square feet. $199,000 Contact Lauren Callaway with eXp Realty: 888-519-7431 From the Zillow

item.title: This is unique! Circa 1940 in California. $699,996
item.description: This house sure is unique! Could be really nice with some work! The house was built in 1940. It is located in Sun Valley, California. The house features arched entryways, coved ceiling, baseboards and a large veranda. There are multiple patios and unique outdoor spaces. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,544 square feet. $699,996 Contact Brad Korb with Brad Korb Real Estate From the Zillow listing: Welcome to this truly unique property in La Tuna Canyon!
